name: hoshi-no-tani
description: Fork this and build your own world with an AI coding agent. A procedural Ghibli-style valley — grass, weather, a steam train and the soundtrack, all generated by code — restructured into 22 documented modules with an AGENTS.md. Original by Lentils.

paragraphs: A late-summer afternoon in a valley that does not exist. Every blade of grass, every stone in the viaduct, every cloud, and every note of the soundtrack is generated by code — no textures, no 3D models, no audio recordings anywhere in this repository.

This repo exists to be taken apart. The demo arrived as a single 6,184-line HTML file, which is a wonderful thing to look at and a challenging thing to expand upon. It is now 22 documented modules with an AGENTS.md, a build system, and checks that catch the mistakes a rendered frame will not show you. Fork it, point an AI coding agent at it, and grow it into something of your own.

Originally created by Lentils, who built it with Claude Opus 5 and shared it in this post on X. That post is where this project came from — watch the video there to see the grass move, which a still cannot show you. Everything you see in the demo is their work; this fork reorganises it so it is easier to pick up and extend. See Attribution.
